selection_reasoning: These three tasks form a spatial exploration and mining chain. The player must first locate a mossy stone brick structure (navigation task), which leads them to a cartography table placed within/near that structure (mining task requiring the player to have found the location), and finally mine black terracotta hidden behind or within the same structure area (requiring the player to have cleared/explored the cartography table area). All tasks are observable, verifiable via inventory/block checks, and don't require deep Minecraft crafting knowledge — just navigation and block-breaking. The dependency is primarily spatial: each task guides the player to the next objective's location.
